title: Paper Replications and Experiments
description:
Paper Replications and Experiments is a collection of from-scratch PyTorch implementations replicating classic and state-of-the-art AI/ML papers, plus post-training experiments on top of them: transformer variants, attention mechanisms, GANs, diffusion models, CLIP-style vision-language models, LoRA and MoE fine-tuning, SFT and GRPO runs, and more.

Paper code and notebooks are licenced under Apache-2.0. Documentation, diagrams, generated results and published experiment artifacts are licensed under CC BY 4.0.
